Capture a creature, solve its sequence and store its soul.
Cast, learn spells and leave your body.
Capture a grown farm animal for your first extraction.

Craft a Bone Cage and place it with two blocks of height and clear space at the doors. Right-click to open it. An open, empty cage pulls creatures from six blocks away and shuts when it catches one.\
\
Start with a grown farm animal for a Benign soul. Keep the doors closed for extraction.

Opening the cage releases its captive. Breaking the cage does too. The first player to use an unowned cage becomes its keeper; only the keeper can operate its doors by hand.\
\
Sneak-right-click to open its screen. Another player’s tamed pet cannot be captured.

Power either half to open the cage. Remove power to close it. Capture shuts the doors even while powered; turn the signal off and on to reopen them.\
\
If a captive seems missing, load its area first. Clear lost removes a missing binding and frees any surviving captive when its chunk loads.
Solve four glassware positions and bottle a Benign soul.

At the cage’s lower-block height, build:\
\
Cage → Funnel → 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → exit\
\
Put the Funnel behind the cage, opposite its doors. Adjacent glass pieces align automatically, whichever way you face. Leave the exit large enough for the captured creature.

Fill the four positions with Decanters, Splitters, Gourds or Spirals. Repeats are allowed. Close the cage on a grown living creature, then power the Funnel.\
\
One piece is checked each second. Green means correct. The first wrong piece turns red and stops the attempt. No soul is taken on failure.

Replace only the first red piece. Turn the Funnel’s power off, then on to try again. Keep testing until all four pieces turn green.\
\
Write down the result. Each soul kind uses the same sequence throughout this world, including other dimensions. A new world may use different sequences.

When all four pieces pass, a spirit appears at the exit. Right-click it with a glass bottle. The captive loses its soul and withers.\
\
Repeat with a new captive and a fresh redstone pulse. Undead, babies, summoned creatures, God Soul sources and already-extracted creatures cannot supply ordinary souls.
Check that the cage is closed and the line has exactly four connected pieces. Clear the exit and cycle the Funnel’s power.
A red piece means the sequence is wrong at that position. A red Funnel can mean the captive has no soul. A blocked exit leaves the captive intact.
Build the twelve-stone frame and deposit bottled souls.

Place twelve Soul Stone blocks in a flat 5×5 frame: three along each side, with the four corners missing. Leave the inner 3×3 clear.\
\
The portal forms automatically. Stone tendrils grow from the frame; leave two blocks of headroom above it.

Right-click the ring or portal with bottled souls to deposit them and recover the glass bottles. You can also use the screen's input slot and Deposit Soul button.\
\
The well holds 64 of each ordinary kind: 512 total. God Souls cannot enter it. Click a kind to bottle one, or shift-click for a stack. Bring empty glass bottles.

Press Filter workers, then set a kind to Keep to reserve it. Kept kinds appear red and cannot become machine workers. You can still bottle them back out.\
\
Breaking the frame releases every stored soul into the world. Bring bottles or another well to recover them.

Machines draw workers from the nearest loaded well within 32 blocks in the same dimension. Keep the well unpowered and leave at least one kind available for workers.\
\
A nearer empty well blocks access to a farther full one.
Build only the twelve Soul Stone frame blocks. Leave the middle clear; the portal forms itself.
Choose creatures that supply the soul kind you need.

Benign: passive farm animals.\
Predatory: spiders, wolves, foxes, cats and other hunters.\
Doomed: witches, pillagers, other illagers, cave spiders.\
Unhinged: creepers, slimes, silverfish, breezes, vexes and ravagers.

Aquatic: fish, squid and other aquatic creatures.\
Ender: endermen, endermites and shulkers.\
Infernal: living Nether creatures, such as blazes, striders and piglins.\
Wise: villagers, wandering traders, allays and iron golems.
Undead are soulless, except for the Wither's God Soul.

Slay an Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden, Elder Guardian or a summoned cosmic god with a Saronite Sword while carrying a glass bottle. Each kill fills one bottle with a God Soul. Five God Souls make a Ring of Power; one makes a god at the Deity Fabricator.
Arrows and cage extraction cannot collect them. God Souls cannot enter Soul Wells or serve as workers.

Soul bottles stack to 16. Right-click any wandering spirit with a glass bottle to catch it. Spirits cannot be milked, sheared, bred or traded with. Killing one gives no loot or experience.\
\
An aging spirit keeps its creature form as a persistent loose soul. It never becomes a free bottled item. Souls released from storage use a form matching their kind.
Carry Foci and fresh Benign souls. Cast Growth or Mend.

Make [Foci](entry://anima:codex/components/soul_focus) and carry fresh bottled Benign souls. Left-click with Foci to choose a spell, then right-click to cast.\
\
Growth and Mend are known from the start. Try Growth beside crops or Mend while injured.

The spell menu lists each spell’s cost and cooldown. Spells use fresh bottled souls in your inventory or carried Soul Gems. Spent bottles return to you.\
\
Soul Well contents and worn workers cannot pay. Hold Foci in either hand to see your carried soul counts.

Read the on-screen message. You may need a target, a clear destination or time for the cooldown to finish. Failed casts spend no souls.\
\
For Kiln, hold Foci in your main hand and the smelting input in your offhand. Learn other spells by translating encrypted books.
Translate an encrypted book and learn its spell.

Explore structure chests for encrypted spell books. Safer chests have a 15%% chance; ordinary dungeon and structure loot has a 35%% chance. High-value loot such as stronghold libraries, ancient cities and End cities guarantees a book in supported loot tables.\
\
Rarer spells are more likely in harder loot.

Build a Research Table within 32 blocks of a stocked Soul Well. Place an encrypted spell book in the tome slot and Blue Crystals in the crystal slot.\
\
Each 15-second attempt consumes one crystal and wears the worker by 5. Success chance is 25%%. Failed attempts keep the encrypted book.

Collect the translated book and right-click it. Learning consumes the book; known spells remain known after death. The table waits while Output is occupied.\
\
A Wise worker lasts 30 durability; other kinds last 20. Check the nearest well and its Keep filters if no worker arrives.

Put ordinary books in the tome slot instead of an encrypted book. Each five-second attempt consumes one book and one Blue Crystal, and wears the worker by 2.\
\
There is a 5%% chance to produce an encrypted spell book. Translate it normally. This is a slow alternative to exploring.
Learn Incorporeal to fly as a spirit and possess creatures.

Start projection on dry, solid ground with room to stand. Mirror and Incorporeal flight cannot pass through terrain. Your visible body stays behind and can be attacked. Its wounds, armor wear and death affect you. Shelter it before leaving.\
\
Timeout and logout return you to your body. Interrupted projections recover on login.

Cast Incorporeal for one Wise and one Ender soul. You have ten minutes. Right-click a creature within five blocks and clear sight to possess it.\
\
Sneak + right-click to leave the host. Release right-click, then sneak + right-click again to return to your body. Sneaking alone does not end the spell.

Astral Form and Incorporeal show your body’s red hearts with the form name and remaining time in one panel. Possession adds the host’s horse-style hearts above them. Large hosts use up to three scaled heart rows.\
\
Control hints appear briefly on entry; hold sneak to recall them. Your body remains vulnerable.
Players, spirits, caged creatures, occupied mounts and possessed hosts are excluded. Soul Leash also rejects hostile types and creatures attacking you. Incorporeal can inhabit eligible hostiles.

You control movement only. Flying and swimming hosts can move vertically. Host death releases Incorporeal as a ghost. If a host is beneath a low ceiling, you reappear at your last safe spirit position.
Carry extra souls in a Soul Gem.

A Soul Gem is a pouch with four slots for bottled souls. Right-click to open it. Each slot holds a stack of up to 16 souls.\
\
Spells and Altar of Souls offerings count fresh bottles inside every carried Soul Gem. The Infusion Table instead requires the offered soul bottle in your hand.
Optional: use a Mirror for a short projection without learning a spell.

Right-click a Mirror for 60 seconds of spirit flight. One Mirror breaks when projection begins. It costs no souls and cannot possess creatures.\
\
Right-click anywhere to return early. Sneak moves downward. Failed activation keeps the Mirror.
Use Spirit Thread to make a consumable possession item.

Right-click a non-hostile creature within normal interaction reach to possess it for up to ten minutes. One Soul Leash is consumed on success; no spell or soul payment is needed.\
\
Move and jump normally. Sneak to return directly to your body. Host death, removal or cage capture also returns you.

A Soul Leash works on eligible non-hostile creatures and your own Workshop Golem. Hostile creatures, spirits, caged creatures and another player’s golem cannot be used.\
\
Your body stays behind and can be hurt. Return with sneak. A leash is consumed only when possession succeeds.
